unchanged_metadata_scanner.candidate_order: API-returned order, with no ranking, resorting, extension, or rerun to seek a different task.
unchanged_metadata_scanner.per_repository_selection: The first metadata-eligible merged bugfix in the returned order; at most one candidate per repository.

metadata_predicates.file_metadata_pagination: Original v2 scan: per_page=100 until fewer than 100; refusal if 3000-file API ceiling is not closed.
metadata_predicates.production_changed_status: Every production .py file is modified, hence preexisting.
metadata_predicates.tests_classifier: Original v2 is_test: .py plus test/tests/testing component, test_ basename, _test.py suffix, or conftest.py.
metadata_predicates.title_or_label: Case-insensitive title starts fix OR a label contains bug.

unchanged_metadata_scanner.metadata_only_bindings: Bind selected base/head commits and changed blobs with allowed Git metadata; retain binding failures without retargeting.
unchanged_metadata_scanner.new_query_exposure_boundary: No PR bodies, patches, raw source/blob content, test contents, CI results, source/configuration inspection, or native outcomes during metadata curation.

pool_and_screening_rules.roles: Choose the first two source-distinct independently admitted pool members in the precommitted order for TRAINING and PROTECTED_FUTURE_1.
pool_and_screening_rules.shortfall: Stop and retain the complete shortfall/refusal record; do not substitute a repository, extend the latest-100 window, rerank, or change predicates.
pool_and_screening_rules.training_without_failing_native_residual: Stop G2 UNKNOWN; do not replace the selected task.
pool_and_screening_rules.screen_once_interpretation: One fixed independent-admission procedure per pool member, within the inherited maximum of two native executions per case; no later retry or rescreening for eligibility.

selection_bias_controls.limitations: This is a declared purposive source-diverse sample drawn from public-name familiarity, not a random or population-representative sample; it supports no inference about an admission or native success rate.

exposure_attestation.prior_familiarity_scope: The proposer has general preexisting model familiarity with these public repository names and broad purposes. No claim is made that the models or humans have never encountered their source, issues, tests, or examples in prior training or work.
exposure_attestation.specific_target_knowledge_used: No specific candidate PR number, target bug, patch, test outcome, or winning implementation method was recalled or used to choose these names.
exposure_attestation.history_access_detail: The initial read rendered the allowed records as records, including embedded historical environment/admission-gate summary pointers or status in V4 records; these were not repository-choice evidence. No referenced pointer target or raw task/diagnostic/outcome file was opened.
exposure_attestation.offline_secondary_review: An attempted no-tools conceptual-review subagent spawn was rejected by the thread limit; no secondary agent ran and no independent review is claimed.
